prediction.statistic: per reader at kept step g, the answer-flip rate between the STALE arm (the step-0 writer's prompt cache) and FRESH (the reader's own) over the 1,319 GSM8K test prompts, greedy, 256 new tokens; the answer is the run's reward extraction (the number after the last #### marker, else the last number; None when none); a seeded bootstrap over prompts (2,000 reps) carries the interval. The accuracy difference STALE - FRESH in points is descriptive.
